scope: Additional Android visual decisions after corrected input gate. Original primary manual/grades retained. Identical PNG sequences are inspected once and SHA-bound to each actual observation; no new discoveries receive own-review detection credit.

decisions.reason: Reviewed original state PNGs (or byte-identical original PNG sequences bound in android-visual-index.json) at native logical width. Queue, inspector, selected markers, stacked controls, summary and all four notes are readable, ordered and free of component clipping/overlap. Offscreen portions of the parent ScrollView are not clipping. FAIL: visible canvas inside component bounds inherits blue-gray #EDF1F6 in light appearance / near-black #0D1420 in dark appearance, instead of the brief/reference canvas #FFFFFF / #1C1424. Production root Column lacks a canvas background/role; the actual native host paints these alternate colors, which show through the component’s internal gaps. This establishes a component canvas omission from design, images and source; it does not score host padding or the observer sentinel. Rendered pixel samples corroborate appearance only, not computed native style. Original loaded/replaced native interval union is complete.
